title: Vendor Invoice and Credit Note Reconciliation
summary: Match vendor invoices, GRNs, RTVs and credit notes, recalculate what each vendor owes you from the agreements, and chase missing or short credit notes with evidence.

seo.title: Vendor Invoice and Credit Note Reconciliation | VipraTech
seo.description: AI reconciles vendor invoices, GRNs, returns to vendor and credit notes for retailers, recalculates amounts due and flags missing or short credit notes.

problem.intro: Retailers and quick-commerce operators deal with hundreds of vendors, each sending invoices, credit notes and statements in their own format. Credit notes for short supply, damages, returns to vendor, price drops and promotional support are agreed in one place and issued, or not, somewhere else.

pain_points.title: Credit notes that never arrive
pain_points.detail: Credit notes promised for RTVs, damages or price protection are missed, short or applied to the wrong invoice, and nobody tracks the balance.

pain_points.title: Vendor statements that do not agree
pain_points.detail: Vendor statements of account and your ledger disagree, and finding the difference means going through months of transactions line by line.

pain_points.title: Evidence scattered across systems
pain_points.detail: Short receipts sit in the WMS, RTV notes in store systems, promo agreements in email and credit notes in PDF attachments.

pain_points.title: GST mismatches
pain_points.detail: Credit notes that do not reference the right invoice, or are missing from GSTR-2B, affect input tax credit and need follow-up.

solution.overview: We build a reconciliation engine that brings together vendor invoices, GRNs, short-receipt and damage reports, return-to-vendor notes, promotional and price-protection agreements, credit notes and vendor statements. OCR and an LLM read the PDFs and spreadsheets vendors send. For each trigger event, such as an RTV or a price drop, the system recalculates the credit you are owed from the agreement and source quantities, then matches it to credit notes received. Missing, short and duplicate credit notes are flagged with evidence. Finance approves adjustments, and the system drafts vendor dispute emails and an open-items ageing report.
capabilities: Reads vendor invoices, credit notes, debit notes and statements in PDF, scan and spreadsheet form
Links each expected credit to its trigger: short GRN, damage report, RTV, price drop or promo agreement
Recalculates expected credit amounts from agreements and source quantities, not from vendor documents
Flags missing, short, duplicate and misapplied credit notes
Reconciles vendor statements of account against your ledger and lists differences with reasons
Drafts vendor dispute emails with the evidence attached and tracks responses

workflow.title: Gather documents and events
workflow.detail: Vendor documents come from email and portals; GRN, RTV and promo data come from the WMS, ERP and category teams.

workflow.title: Extract and normalise
workflow.detail: Invoices, credit notes and statements are read into a common structure with confidence scores.

workflow.title: Recalculate expected credits
workflow.detail: For each trigger event, the expected credit is calculated from agreements and source quantities.

workflow.title: Match and flag
workflow.detail: Expected credits are matched to credit notes received; gaps, shorts and duplicates are flagged.

workflow.title: Finance review
workflow.detail: Vendor accounts reviews exceptions, confirms adjustments and approves dispute emails.

workflow.title: Post and track
workflow.detail: Approved entries are posted to the ERP, and open items are aged and followed up.

inputs: Vendor invoices, credit notes and debit notes
GRN, short-receipt and damage reports from the WMS
outputs: List of missing, short, duplicate and misapplied credit notes with evidence
human_in_the_loop: Vendor accounts approve every adjustment and every dispute sent to a vendor, and category managers confirm the terms of promotional and price-protection agreements. Uncertain lines are flagged for review rather than passed.
integrations: ERP such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or Tally
WMS and store systems for GRN and RTV data
guardrails: Expected credits recalculated from agreements and source data, not copied from vendor documents
Uncertain lines flagged, never silently matched
Duplicate credit note detection across periods
Full audit trail of matches, edits and approvals
compliance_notes: Credit notes are checked for references to the original invoice, which supports your tax team's GST and GSTR-2B reconciliation.
The audit trail supports statutory audit of vendor balances.

pilot.scope: The top vendors of one category for one quarter, using your finance team's completed reconciliation as the benchmark.
deliverables: Agreed rules for each credit type
Working reconciliation for the pilot vendors

what_we_measure.how: Line-level results compared with your finance team's completed reconciliation for the same period.
Missing or short credit notes found with evidence and confirmed by vendor accounts.
Lines routed to review per vendor, by reason.
Effort to close a vendor reconciliation, with and without the system.

faqs.q: Vendors send statements in every format. Will that work?
faqs.a: Yes. Statements and credit notes are read in context, whether PDF, scan or spreadsheet, and mapped to a common structure. For your own system exports, such as GRN and RTV reports, we agree and freeze the formats before go-live.

faqs.q: Who decides whether a vendor owes us money?
faqs.a: Your finance team. The system shows the recalculated amount, the agreement and the source quantities side by side, and finance approves any adjustment or dispute.

faqs.q: Can brands use this to reconcile deductions from retailers and quick-commerce platforms?
faqs.a: Yes. The same engine works in reverse, matching debit notes and deductions raised by modern trade and quick-commerce accounts against your invoices, delivery proofs and agreed terms.

faqs.q: Does it post entries in our ERP?
faqs.a: It prepares adjustment entries for your ERP through an API, import file or staging table, and posts only after finance approval.
